cast.name: Dark Spot Villain
cast.description: tiny flat brown Dark Spot blob stamping dots on the sleeping woman's cheek, leader of the villain gang; sneaky, hissing, conspiratorial whisper

cast.name: DERMDOC Kojic Night Cream Jar
cast.description: the white-and-blue DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid night cream jar on the bedside table, wakes up and lifts its lid; low, warm, sly hushed cartoon voice

cast.name: Kojic Acid
cast.description: golden spiky Kojic Acid ball hero leading the night team out of the jar; bossy, cute, hushed little foreman cartoon voice

cast.name: Narrator
cast.description: off-screen voiceover over the cream application; soft, warm, calm bedtime-story voice

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Working through the night for brighter, even-looking skin.
lines.bn: সারা রাত ধরে কাজ, ব্রাইটার আর ইভেন লুকিং স্কিনের জন্য।
lines.ta: ராத்திரி முழுக்க வேலை, ப்ரைட்டர், ஈவன் லுக்கிங் ஸ்கின்னுக்காக.
lines.te: రాత్రంతా పని, బ్రైటర్, ఈవెన్ లుకింగ్ స్కిన్ కోసం.
lines.ml: രാത്രി മുഴുവൻ പണി, ബ്രൈറ്റർ, ഈവൻ ലുക്കിംഗ് സ്കിന്നിനായി.
lines.or: ରାତିସାରା କାମ, ବ୍ରାଇଟର ଆଉ ଇଭେନ ଲୁକିଂ ସ୍କିନ ପାଇଁ।

lines.speaker: knc_jar
lines.en: Dark spots don't get the night off.
lines.or: ଡାର୍କ ସ୍ପଟର ରାତିରେ ବି ଛୁଟି ନାହିଁ!

notes: Hushed bedtime scene: the villain, jar and Kojic lines are whispered in the original, so they are tagged neutral to keep them quiet. Line 2 is literally 'So is my night team.', a reply to 'she's asleep' that means the jar's night team is awake and on duty; it is transcreated to that meaning. Line 5 is labelled JAR DIALOGUE in the prompt and the jar is on screen, so it goes to the jar. Its pitch (~185 Hz) is close to the voiceover (~187 Hz), while line 2 is ~145 Hz. The jar gets -2 st so it stays lower and warmer than the narrator. If line 5 turns out to be the narrator's voice, the engineer can drop the second jar ref range. 'Keep it down. We're working.' is one Kojic line per the prompt (the pitch dip on 'We're working' is whisper noise). Kojic gets +3 st to separate it from the jar. Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, the Dullness and Uneven Tone villains and the sleeping woman never speak. The prompt's on-screen ingredient beats (about 7 to 11.4 s) have no dialogue. Whisper's voice_cluster_hint was ignored.
